theory.name: Nomological Ring Axioms
theory.author: M-Tokuni
theory.description: A structural framework describing existence as continuous generation and state transition, with structural play as the persistence condition.

first_axiom.note: Defines existence as an ongoing generative process. The world is a historical generative structure rather than a collection of static states.
consequences: The world is a historical generative structure

second_axiom.jp_original: 遊びのない厳密さは崩壊する
second_axiom.note: Presupposes the first axiom but is not derived from it. Specifies the condition required for the generative structure defined by the first axiom to persist as a real system.

play.not: Colloquial sense of leisure or surplus

theoretical_layer.result: R = delta / tau is undefined (out of domain)
theoretical_layer.meaning: System is mathematically non-describable; this is not Fail-Closed but a switch of description system

operational_layer.condition: tau > 0 and tau is sufficiently small
operational_layer.result: R = delta / tau is defined but diverges rapidly
operational_layer.meaning: Fail-Closed is an operational judgment, distinct from theoretical non-describability

design_principles: Determine what to track rigorously and what to allow to play
Allocate the play width tau across dimensions
Operate the play utilization rate R within the survival range

derived_principles.fail_closed: Operational judgment when play utilization R exceeds threshold
derived_principles.no_reverse_calculation: Re-estimation chains transform errors and reduce play
derived_principles.all_variables_dynamic: Static variables do not exercise play in their dimension
derived_principles.distance_is_result: Distance is a static index that ignores play

axiom_relation.description: AX2 presupposes AX1 but is not logically derived from AX1. AX1 defines what existence is. AX2 defines the condition under which that existence persists as a real system.
axiom_relation.first_axiom_role: Defines the concept of generation; complete within itself
axiom_relation.second_axiom_role: Specifies the condition required when describing the object of the first axiom as a real system
axiom_relation.logical_classification: Neither independent parallel nor derived corollary; the second axiom requires the first as prerequisite while making an independent claim that does not follow automatically from the first

intensional_dynamics.description: The world is interpreted as an intensional dynamic structure driven by internal constraints.
properties: Time is ordering of state transition

tau.name: Absorption Thickness
tau.second_axiom_interpretation: Structural play width in the engineering sense

boundary_condition.meaning: Structural limit reached; play fully consumed; departure from survival space

domain_constraint.meaning: Per the second axiom, tau = 0 places the system outside the NRA-IDE description domain

ide_specification.name: Intensional Dynamics Engine
ide_specification.role: Operational mechanism that evaluates structural state based on NRA.
principles: IDE does not make final decisions
IDE designs the allocation of play across system dimensions

fail_closed_rule.description: When structural limit is reached (R >= 1 in the operational layer), system output is restricted and control is transferred to human decision.
fail_closed_rule.distinction_from_non_describability: Fail-Closed is operational; non-describability (tau = 0) is theoretical

changes: Restructured core_axiom into axioms.first_axiom and axioms.second_axiom
Added axiom_relation to clarify the dependent (non-independent, non-derived) relation between AX1 and AX2
Added second_axiom_interpretation fields to tau and R in structural_ratio
Added IDE principle: 'IDE designs the allocation of play across system dimensions'
First axiom 'Existence is generation' as core_axiom
